<a id="zipzi-values-vertexcontentpatch"></a>

## zipzi.values.VertexContentPatch

```python
class VertexContentPatch(Value)
```

Optional updates to one stable mesh vertex in a selected shape.

| Field | Type | Constructor default (wire JSON) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `vertex_id` | `int` | Required | Stable u32 vertex ID within the mesh, not an offset into its position array. |
| `position` | `common.Vec2 \| None` | `null` (`None`) | Replacement XY value: absolute for Base/Ordinary, displacement for BlendShape.<br>None preserves the current value in the selected shape. |
| `uv` | `common.Vec2 \| None` | `null` (`None`) | Optional texture UV pair; None preserves the current UV. UV updates are permitted only<br>for the Base shape, because UV coordinates are shared by all shapes. |
